Facts: Sun obtained 5 false VAT special invoices (虚开增值税专用发票) with no real transaction, used them to claim input tax deduction, defrauding tax of 77517.1 yuan. This is virtual issuance of VAT special invoices used for tax deduction. According to correction lessons: correct label is 【虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票;经济犯】? Wait earlier examples: For similar case (first example) they labeled "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票;经济犯". That case involved using invoices to get export tax refund. Here they used for input tax deduction (抵扣税款). So label should be "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票". The "经济犯" maybe a category? In examples they sometimes add ";经济犯". The first example: "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票;经济犯". That includes both the specific crime and a broader category? The instruction says "Correct label 【虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票;逃税】 (not ...)" But the correction says for similar scenario should include both "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票;逃税". The current case: they used false invoices to get input tax deduction, which is a form of tax evasion (逃税). So correct label likely "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票;逃税".
